newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Tractor's HK shr offer seen 290x subscribed.
newsitem.headline: First Tractor's HK shr offer seen 290x subscribed.

text.p: The Hong Kong public offering portion of H-shares in Chinese agricultural tractor maker First Tractor Co Ltd is expected to be about 290 times subscribed, market sources said on Tuesday.
"The issue is seen to be about 290 to 300 times subscribed," a source close to the flotation said.
First Tractor is expected to make an official announcement on the subscription results on Thursday.
The Chinese tractor maker offered 300 million H shares, or 40 percent of the company enlarged share capital, in a global flotation at HK$4.50 per share.
Of the total, 255 million H shares is earmarked for international placement, and 45 million shares is offered for public subscription in Hong Kong.
Dealing in the company's shares is expected to commence on June 23.
H shares are Chinese enterprise shares listed in Hong Kong.
